answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 18 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in voyage, checked in violet, and vault makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 45 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
